title: What the market sees versus what the person carries

columns.label: What a person may carry
columns.description: Unobserved situational constraints and household needs

caption: A conceptual contrast between transaction-level signals and the wider conditions that can shape an individual decision.
scopeLimits: The table does not claim that all markets see only these signals, or that an individual path is inadequate.
limitations: Qualitative conceptual contrast; not an empirical study of consumer telemetry.

accessibility.textEquivalent: Contrast table comparing observable marketplace telemetry with unobserved participant constraints.
